title: Comparing Your Real Options for Selling Software Without a Stripe Account for Digital Creators
author: COREMERCH
excerpt: Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, and Lemon Squeezy block creators in dozens of countries. Here is the sovereign infrastructure that works everywhere they do not.

content.text: As a digital creator in Nigeria, Ghana, or Pakistan, you're likely blocked from using Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle - but that's not a limitation, it's a design choice. These platforms intentionally restrict access to certain countries, and it's up to you to choose a better architecture. The question is, what's the right path forward for selling software without a Stripe account?
What Each Option Actually Offers

Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy promise ease of use, but they come with steep fees and limited customization options. PayPal offers a payment gateway, but it's notorious for its strict policies and frozen accounts. Meanwhile, NOWPayments is a payment processor that integrates with a wide range of cryptocurrencies, but it requires technical expertise to set up. In contrast, the Sovereign Commerce Stack offers full infrastructure sovereignty, no platform dependencies, and a flat 0.5% fee on all transactions.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad all have strict country restrictions, blocking creators in Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan from using their services. NOWPayments doesn't have these limitations, but it's still a commercial service that requires a minimum transaction volume to justify the setup costs. The Sovereign Commerce Stack, on the other hand, is designed to be fully accessible in countries with restricted access to commercial services.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

NOWPayments charges a flat 0.5% fee on all transactions, regardless of the cryptocurrency used. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy charge higher fees, ranging from 3.5% to 12.5% depending on the payment method and country. Stripe and PayPal also charge varying fees, including a flat rate of 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction for domestic transactions. Meanwhile, the Sovereign Commerce Stack offers a flat 0.5% fee, with no hidden charges or restrictions.
The Sovereign Commerce Stack offers full infrastructure sovereignty and automation capabilities, making it the better choice for creators who want control over their sales infrastructure.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

With the Sovereign Commerce Stack, you own all the infrastructure and data, with no platform dependencies to worry about. You can automate product delivery and payment processing using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and deliver files from Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. NOWPayments integrates seamlessly with these services, making it easy to set up a fully automated digital commerce stack.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you're looking for a commercial payment processor with no country restrictions, NOWPayments is a good choice. However, if you want to own your infrastructure, automate your payment processing, and avoid commercial fees, the Sovereign Commerce Stack is the better option. Either way, make sure you're not locked into a platform's limitations - choose a path that gives you full control over your sales infrastructure.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. The key difference between this and a platform workaround is structural: there is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow. Your funds go directly to a wallet you control the moment a transaction confirms.
NOWPayments is a good commercial payment processor option, but it requires technical expertise to set up and comes with a minimum transaction volume requirement.
